label: A2B_tI12_141_e_a-001
title: Anatase (TiO$_{2}$, $C5$) Structure
comments:
TiO$_{2}$ can also be found as \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_tP6_136_f_a-001}{rutile ($C4$)} and \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_oP24_61_2c_c-001}{brookite ($C21$)}. 
 (Howard, 1991) gives the positions of the atoms in terms of setting 1 of space group $I4_{1}/amd$ \#141. When we originally translated this to our standard setting 2 we entered an incorrect position for the oxygen z coordinate, giving incorrect Ti-O bond lengths and angles. This has been corrected in the current version of the CIF and the POSCAR. 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_tI12_141_e_a-001}{Anatase TiO$_{2}$ ($C5$)}, \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_tI12_141_e_a-002}{$\alpha$-ThSi$_{2}$ ($C_{c}$)}, and \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_tI12_141_e_a-003}{$\beta$-Mo$_{2}$N} share the same AFLOW prototype label, A2B\_tI12\_141\_e\_a. The structures are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files.
